crankNote: backup cranker and Claim keeper. A crank is sent only once its quarter has been bound for crankDelayEpochs (2880 = one day), so the primary cranker goes first; at most crankMaxFeeFil per message. The Claim keeper claims a stream when nobody has claimed it for claimEveryHours (24 = daily, today's behaviour; raise to 192 once fidlabs/solstice-cranker sends the weekly Claim, to make this a backup), at most claimMaxFeeFil per message and 10% of the payout. absenceAlertHours / gateAlertHours: when bin/watch.js calls submitShares / the gate check overdue. Keys: CRANK_KEY_MAINNET (f410, 'cranker (watchtower backup)') and CLAIM_KEY_MAINNET (f1, 'claimer (watchtower backup)'), secrets of the production environment; without them the steps are dry runs.

feeWatch.note: bin/fees.js: FIP-0118 FIL price recomputed from the fee auctions of the admitted Filecoin Pay contract (the admitted lists and pricing parameters themselves are read from the SRA events in records.jsonl). filUsdSane: a reference outside it is alerted weekly. potAlertUsd: a pot at least this large is alerted weekly with what it costs to take. divergenceRatio: the two auctions' last prints further apart than this. partialToleranceUsd / overpayPercent: how much of the pot a claim may leave, and how far above the auction price it may pay, before it counts as a chosen print. knownClaimers: the weekly fee harvesters seen since 2026-09; a claim by anyone else is flagged. The node keeps traces for 14 days, so fees.json was seeded up to epoch 6539999 from claims decoded on Blockscout.
